PullRequest.Title: sessions: add explicit worktree option to create_session
PullRequest.Body:
## Summary
- Add an optional `worktree` override to `create_session`, with guidance to supply true or false only when explicitly requested by the user.
- Preserve existing isolation inheritance when omitted and reject the option with `relationship: currentSession`.
- When `worktree: false`, resolve a known worktree folder to its project root instead of sharing the existing worktree.
- Cover explicit overrides, invalid combinations, inheritance, and local/remote workspace resolution in regression tests; update architecture documentation.

## Validation
- `npm run compile` passed.
- Hygiene passed for all changed files (including the pre-commit hook).
- 90 focused session tool and tool-group tests passed; the final description-only change also passed both targeted schema/guidance tests.

Scenarios.Scenario: Create a peer chat with relationship=currentSession
Scenarios.CriticalPath: Argument validation proceeds directly to createChat, rename, and prompt dispatch. The new worktree lookup is unreachable because worktree is rejected for currentSession and the catalog helper returns without listing sessions.

ExpensiveBoundaries.Operation: Create and initialize the peer chat, then dispatch the initial prompt.
ExpensiveBoundaries.Cardinality: One chat creation and one prompt dispatch per accepted tool call.
ExpensiveBoundaries.PreviousBehavior: The same peer-chat creation and prompt path ran before the diff.
ExpensiveBoundaries.CriticalPathEffect: Both must complete in the existing order before the tool returns.

Scenarios.ScalingInput: One explicitly confirmed tool call; no worktree collection is traversed.
Scenarios.EffectiveConcurrency: Uses the existing server-tool execution path and process-wide chat count; this diff adds no parallelism, queue, or boundary operation.
Scenarios.CacheBehavior: No changed cache behavior. Session catalog and worktree caches are not consulted on this relationship.
Scenarios.MechanismConfidence: High: the relationship branch returns before the new getWorktreeRoots call.
Scenarios.MagnitudeUncertainty: Provider-specific chat latency varies, but the diff does not alter it.
Scenarios.Verdict: No performance regression; the changed schema/validation does not add runtime work to current-session chat creation.

Scenarios.Scenario: Create an independent session with worktree omitted or true
Scenarios.CriticalPath: The existing session catalog lookup resolves the workspace, then session configuration/provider creation, title update, and prompt dispatch run. The new getWorktreeRoots branch is skipped.

ExpensiveBoundaries.Operation: Enumerate registered sessions and resolve provider metadata for workspace-name/path matching.
ExpensiveBoundaries.Cardinality: One logical catalog request per create call, shared with concurrent same-mode requests; downstream metadata work scales with the effective registered-session catalog and is concurrency-limited.
ExpensiveBoundaries.PreviousBehavior: Independent create_session already listed sessions to resolve workspace inputs.
ExpensiveBoundaries.CriticalPathEffect: Existing prerequisite for resolving an independent workspace before creation.

ExpensiveBoundaries.Operation: Resolve Git capabilities and branch defaults while resolving host-owned isolation configuration.
ExpensiveBoundaries.Cardinality: One repository-root lookup, one HEAD probe, and branch/default-branch probes per creation, with successful repository roots cached.
ExpensiveBoundaries.PreviousBehavior: The same isolation-config Git probes ran for independent sessions.
ExpensiveBoundaries.CriticalPathEffect: Existing synchronous prerequisite to provider session creation.

ExpensiveBoundaries.Operation: Create the provider chat/session, register it, rename it, and dispatch its first prompt.
ExpensiveBoundaries.Cardinality: One session, registry registration, rename, and prompt dispatch per accepted tool call.
ExpensiveBoundaries.PreviousBehavior: The same provider and persistence operations ran before the diff.

Scenarios.ScalingInput: One workspace and one new session per confirmed invocation; process-wide creation is intended to be bounded at 25 completed creations.
Scenarios.EffectiveConcurrency: Concurrent catalog requests are coalesced by AgentService.listSessions per mode; provider creation retains its existing concurrency behavior. This diff adds no new concurrent work on this path.
Scenarios.CacheBehavior: Session-list computations are coalesced while in flight. Repository-root discovery during session configuration retains its existing bounded LRU cache. No changed cache key or invalidation behavior applies.
Scenarios.MechanismConfidence: High: the new conditional only executes for worktree === false.
Scenarios.MagnitudeUncertainty: Provider and catalog latency depend on provider state and catalog size, but none of those costs is increased by this diff when worktree is omitted or true.
Scenarios.Verdict: No performance regression; inherited and explicit worktree creation preserve the prior runtime boundary count.

Scenarios.Scenario: Create an independent session with explicit worktree=false, including a workspace that may be an existing linked worktree
Scenarios.CriticalPath: After the existing catalog lookup and validation, the diff awaits one Git worktree-list probe. If the requested workspace exactly matches a linked root, it substitutes the primary root; then the existing configuration, provider creation, rename, and prompt path proceeds.

ExpensiveBoundaries.Operation: Enumerate sessions to resolve the workspace argument.
ExpensiveBoundaries.Cardinality: One logical catalog request per invocation, with concurrent same-mode requests coalesced.
ExpensiveBoundaries.PreviousBehavior: Independent create_session already performed this catalog lookup.
ExpensiveBoundaries.CriticalPathEffect: Must complete before workspace resolution; unchanged from prior independent creation.

ExpensiveBoundaries.Operation: Run git worktree list --porcelain and parse its reported roots.
ExpensiveBoundaries.Cardinality: Exactly one subprocess per explicit worktree=false invocation, independent of worktree count; output parsing is O(number of registered worktrees).
ExpensiveBoundaries.PreviousBehavior: The option and this pre-creation Git probe did not exist; independent creation proceeded directly to defaults/config resolution.
ExpensiveBoundaries.CriticalPathEffect: Newly awaited before session creation so a linked root can be redirected to its primary checkout; the Git helper has a five-second timeout.

ExpensiveBoundaries.Operation: Resolve repository root, HEAD, current branch, and default branch for session configuration.
ExpensiveBoundaries.Cardinality: A small fixed sequence per creation; repository-root successes use a bounded LRU cache.
ExpensiveBoundaries.PreviousBehavior: Independent session creation already resolved host-owned isolation through these Git probes.
ExpensiveBoundaries.CriticalPathEffect: Must complete before provider creation; this path pre-existed for folder and worktree isolation.

ExpensiveBoundaries.Operation: Create/register the provider session, rename its chat, and dispatch the initial prompt.
ExpensiveBoundaries.PreviousBehavior: The same creation and persistence path ran before the diff.
ExpensiveBoundaries.CriticalPathEffect: Existing downstream critical path after workspace selection.

Scenarios.ScalingInput: One Git listing per explicitly non-worktree create call; parsing scales linearly with the number of registered worktrees in that repository. Session creation is user-confirmed and guarded by the existing process-wide 25-session backstop.
Scenarios.EffectiveConcurrency: The added calls are not cached or coalesced, so separately confirmed creates can run their one probe concurrently. They do not create per-file or per-worktree subprocesses; each invocation remains one subprocess, and the surrounding session-creation path already performs Git/provider work.
Scenarios.CacheBehavior: The direct getWorktreeRoots call has no warm cache, though its result is one bounded porcelain listing. Existing repository-root caching and listSessions in-flight coalescing remain intact. Empty and successful worktree listings are both recomputed on later explicit calls, which preserves current Git state.
Scenarios.MechanismConfidence: High that one uncached subprocess is newly placed on this path; high that it neither fans out nor repeats within a single invocation.
Scenarios.MagnitudeUncertainty: Git process startup and filesystem latency vary, especially on remote or network-backed workspaces, but realistic repository worktree counts are bounded and the probe is only reached for an explicit user-requested behavior.
Scenarios.Verdict: No reportable regression. The single bounded probe is the operation that supplies the feature's required authoritative mapping, runs only on explicit worktree opt-out, and does not materially amplify the already heavier session-creation path.

Analysis.Summary: Completed the performance pass over all 24 changed files and every diff page. Traced current-session, inherited/explicit-worktree, and explicit-no-worktree creation paths through catalog enumeration, Git subprocesses, provider creation, persistence, and prompt dispatch. The only new runtime cost is one bounded git worktree list probe for explicit worktree=false; it is single-shot, critical to exact linked-root resolution, and not a realistic actionable regression. No findings submitted.
